Subject: Post-event follow-up: Redwood demo for Finovate

Hi Olivia,

Thanks again for attending the Redwood session at the Finovate webinar yesterday — really appreciate you taking the time. A few folks on our team thought there could be a good fit between Redwood's inference platform and some of the latency-sensitive features you mentioned (real-time risk scoring + embeddings for feature search).

Would you be open to a short 30-minute product demo next week so we can show a couple of targeted flows and discuss SSO/enterprise requirements? Here are a few quick options from our side:
- Thu Mar 19, 10:00 AM PT
- Thu Mar 19, 1:00 PM PT
- Fri Mar 20, 11:00 AM PT

If none of those work, feel free to pick a time on my calendar: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/demo-30

I can loop in our solutions engineer and AE depending on the areas you want to cover.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
SDR, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0134

Thanks — the webinar was great. The team here is curious to see a demo, especially around model routing and caching. I can do Thu Mar 19 but 10:00 AM PT conflicts with another standup. Would 11:00 AM PT work?

2) We use Okta SSO and have strict onboarding steps for vendor access — can you confirm what information you need from us to evaluate SSO requirements?

Hi Olivia — great, thanks for the quick reply.

We can absolutely bring both an AE and an SE. I’ve CC'd Dev (AE) and Marissa (SE) — they can jump in on the technical SSO and routing discussion.

11:00 AM PT on Thu Mar 19 works for us. I attached a short one-pager and the webinar deck we referenced so your team can skim before the call (see attachments).

For Okta SSO, to start we typically ask for:
- SP metadata or SAML entity ID (if available)
- SSO contact for provisioning/testing
- Whether you require IDP-initiated or SP-initiated SSO

If you'd prefer, Marissa can walk through the SSO checklist during the demo and capture any follow-ups.

I’ve also added a Calendly link for ease (https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/demo-30) — but I’ll send a formal calendar invite once we confirm final attendees.

Attachments: redwood-one-pager.pdf, redwood-webinar-deck.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
